summary: 12 records audited (4 Air-Know, 4 HABIT, 4 INTENT), each re-derived from scratch through four independent routes: my own rowspan/colspan-aware HTML grid parse of the arXiv v1 HTML (plus v2 for Air-Know), pdftotext -layout of the PDF I downloaded and hashed myself, the rendered table-page image, and the author's own results PNG in workbench/third_party (HABIT assets/results-fiq.png, INTENT figs/fiq.png and AirKnow assets/results-fiq.png all re-read as images). Every one of the 108 extracted cells matches the primary source digit-for-digit, and every row really does sit in the noise block the record names - I checked block identity by the surrounding competitor rows (e.g. SPRC 49.18/55.64/59.35 at 0% vs 39.81/48.58/50.48 at 20%), which is the failure mode the assignment flagged. 11 of 12 records are CONFIRMED; the one blemish is airknow_fiq_20pct, PARTIAL, because its derived_metrics entry 'macro_r50_from_categories' = 75.72 contradicts the paper's own printed Average R@50 = 75.71 that the same record reports as PAPER_REPORTED. On the assignment's specific question: the Air-Know record is right and the registry is wrong - workbench/registry/models.yaml:109 carries reported_mean 65.74, while the paper prints 65.73 in Table 1's 0% AVG. cell by all four routes; (55.75+75.72)/2 = 65.735 and the paper truncates to 65.73, so the registry's 65.74 is the ROUND_HALF_UP answer to a question the paper answered by truncation. Reader must not trust: (a) registry reported_mean 65.74 for airknow (P2 transcription defect - fix to 65.73); (b) airknow.json's derived_metrics rounding_policy label 'round-half-even/truncation' (P3, self-contradictory - ROUND_HALF_EVEN on 65.735 yields 65.74) and the redundant re-derivation of means and Average cells the papers already print; (c) the asymmetry in checkpoint_mapping_status - HABIT's VERIFIED rests on the author's explicit per-file Hub statements ('Trained on FashionIQ with 20% noise'), INTENT's UNVERIFIED is honest because its Hub README has no per-file table, but Air-Know's fiq_n05/fiq_n08 VERIFIED rests only on the filename '0.5'/'0.8' plus the Hub README's generic noise list, the same evidence class that INTENT's record declined to call VERIFIED (P3 consistency defect). Nothing beyond rounding-ridge arithmetic failed: the three 'printed mean != mean of unrounded macros' cases (HABIT 0% +0.005, INTENT 0% and 20% -0.0067) are paper-internal and the records disclose them rather than smoothing them. All findings are STATIC_AUDIT; no checkpoint was downloaded, no GPU inference was run, and the questions of whether these numbers reproduce and whether the papers' unstated gallery/reference protocol equals the workbench's fashioniq_full_gallery_ref_excluded remain NOT_RUN/UNKNOWN - the papers establish no gallery construction, and the records correctly say so in verification_evidence while supplying the code-derived best reading.
